title: Team Collaboration
description: Powerful tools for seamless team coordination and communication
content:
Kahana's team collaboration features enable seamless coordination and communication across your organization through powerful link hubs and collaborative tools. Share resources, track progress, and work together efficiently with our comprehensive collaboration platform.

Pro Tip

Create dedicated link hubs for different projects or teams to keep web resources organized and easily accessible. Use tags and smart folders to maintain clear organization.

Link Hubs

Hub Types

  • Project hubs for team collaboration
  • Research hubs for collecting resources
  • Learning hubs for educational content
  • Personal hubs for individual organization

Access Controls

  • Owner: Full control over hub settings
  • Editor: Can add and modify content
  • Contributor: Can add new content
  • Viewer: Read-only access

Link Management

Organization Features

  • One-click saving to hubs
  • Automatic content categorization
  • Custom tags and labels
  • Smart folders with filtering
  • Advanced search capabilities

Rich Metadata

  • Title and description tracking
  • Preview images and snippets
  • Content type identification
  • Version history and changes
  • User notes and comments

Real-time Collaboration

Team Features

  • Simultaneous hub editing
  • Live updates and changes
  • Presence indicators
  • In-hub discussions
  • @mentions and notifications

Task Management

  • Link-based assignments
  • Due dates and reminders
  • Progress tracking
  • Priority levels
  • Status updates
